hotspots.title: Javier Milei’s re-election bid and economic defense
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei convened an intense summit with La Libertad Avanza lawmakers to demand unified defense of his economic model and key central bank reforms. Milei launched explosive tirades against critical journalists and political opponents, calling them 'human shits' while refusing relief for indebted citizens. The administration also faced ongoing scrutiny over internal power struggles between Karina Milei and Santiago Caputo and asset investigations into Cabinet Chief Manuel Adorni.
hotspots.affect: Milei's aggressive rhetoric against press and opposition, combined with high-stakes legislative battles, creates an intense atmosphere of grievance and polarization.

hotspots.title: AfD’s rise and far-right governance threats in Germany
hotspots.blurb: With polls placing the Alternative for Germany (AfD) over 40% ahead of Saxony-Anhalt's September 6 election, public broadcasters MDR and NDR executed temporary screen blackouts to warn viewers of potential far-right media suppression. CDU leaders are locked in fierce debates over maintaining political firewalls as AfD figures face allegations of intimidation and aggressive media tactics. Economists and rival parties warn that an AfD victory could severely harm regional stability and economic growth.
hotspots.affect: Broadcaster blackouts and fears of an unprecedented far-right state government victory generate maximum existential alarm and democratic contention.

hotspots.title: Trump administration’s visa and immigration crackdown
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration announced unprecedented immigration restrictions, including plans to revoke up to 200,000 tourist and business visas held by individuals who later claimed asylum. Officials also proposed raising H-1B skilled worker visa fees to over $103,000 and temporarily paused worldwide visa appointments for consular training. Critics and state officials warn the moves will cripple key labor sectors while expanding aggressive federal enforcement.
hotspots.affect: Drastic fee increases and widespread visa revocations evoke acute panic, outrage, and legal confrontation across political and economic spectrums.

hotspots.title: Italy’s Salvini pushes budget deficit and fuel tax battles
hotspots.blurb: Italian Deputy Prime Minister Matteo Salvini demanded a €20 billion increase in the 2027 budget deficit and aggressive windfall taxes on banks and energy companies to lower surging fuel prices. The push has created sharp tension within the governing coalition with Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, who favors stricter fiscal discipline and targeted relief measures. As diesel prices touch record highs, Salvini faces additional internal party pressure and northern faction dissent.
hotspots.affect: High fuel inflation combined with open coalition infighting over deficit spending and bank taxation creates a high-stakes, populist grievance climate.

hotspots.title: Trump administration threatens Kennedy Center demolition
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration issued an aggressive ultimatum threatening to demolish the historic John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts if courts block planned major renovations. Federal filings suggest replacing the iconic national cultural landmark with an outdoor amphitheater while insisting on adding Trump's name to the venue. The threat has drawn fierce backlash from congressional leaders and heritage advocates who condemn it as cultural blackmail.
hotspots.affect: The threat to raze a national cultural landmark over naming rights and legal disputes triggers immediate shock, cultural outrage, and intense symbolic conflict.
